coverage_gaps.Microsoft AI: The configured AI blog redirects to the Microsoft Source AI topic, whose static and rendered lists lacked dates. The configured feed returned HTTP 410. Alternative ten-entry AI-topic and Source feeds yielded five candidates in total, but alternative feeds do not establish coverage of the configured entry point. Browser follow-up found five homepage articles without dates; the first item in the View all AI posts index was dated May 19 and could not cover the current homepage. RSS access failed in that follow-up. Date coverage remains incomplete; this does not establish no updates.
coverage_gaps.Qwen: The configured GitHub blog remains dated September 23, 2025, which cannot establish no updates. The current qwen.ai/research dynamic list was read: its latest Qwen Image 2.1 entry was September 20, followed by September 18 and 2. The configured entry point remains the old blog, and the scope of the migration cannot be assumed equivalent. Earlier first-screen checks, stale page-config data, empty article retrieval, and supplementary HF creation/GitHub push checks did not provide full release coverage. The entry-point gap remains.
coverage_gaps.阶跃星辰 StepFun: The current official homepage says Step 5 Preview weights are now open; the official model card and repository were checked. This contradicts upstream countdown and not-yet-open observations, so the local targeted verification is used for this source. An HF creation date of September 20 and modification time of October 15 at 01:28 UTC do not establish when the weights became public; GitHub repository creation and push times do not establish that either. The candidate remains pending date verification and was not included as a new release that day. Product names and countdowns are not publication dates.
coverage_gaps.OpenReview: The homepage was accessible. Browser follow-up found News most recently dated September 24, followed by March 23 and February 12. Active Venues (1,062) and Open for Submissions (164) are venue lists, not checks of every venue’s papers. Newly submitted papers were not examined venue by venue; paper-discovery coverage remains incomplete.
coverage_gaps.Ars Technica: The upstream first AI-category page retained 11 window entries, with dated entries extending before the window start. Bodies were not read and syndication was not determined. Two local HTTP attempts and the browser received HTTP 403. Credible candidates saved upstream before 05:00 Beijing are retained; coverage of the final hour remains incomplete.
